messages.text:
I can’t send the refund to your sister’s account. Refunds can only go to the order’s original payment, and the shop can’t redirect one to another person’s account or card. Your old card issuer handles any credit to a cancelled card; the shop can’t promise where or when it appears. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

I’ve proposed BRL 149.65 for your returned Bluetooth speaker. If you want to proceed to the original payment, confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a chat message won’t confirm it. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
